text:
ryan: CI red on eng-runtime unit tests — intermittent failure in TestExecutorDelayedTimer (serving/executor_test.go). Happening ~30% of CI runs. Pushing a rerun now but wanted to flag before I start bisect.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered: build 33155 -> rerun #2. Link: https://ci.redwood/33155 (results posted when done).
maria: @ryan thanks. Is there a minimal repro? flaky in prod or just CI?
ryan: Only CI so far. Locally I can repro ~1/20 with this quick loop: `for i in {1..20}; do go test ./serving -run TestExecutorDelayedTimer -count=1 || break; done`
ryan: quick failing snippet from last run:
```
--- FAIL: TestExecutorDelayedTimer (0.03s)
    executor_test.go:142: expected timer fired, got shutdown before firing
    runtime/serve.go:312: shutdown invoked while timer pending
```
sam: Sounds like timing/jitter. Might be caused by the shutdown-to-requeue change in PR #1452. @lee did you touch timers there?
lee: I changed executor shutdown ordering in #1452 to avoid double-schedule, but didn't touch delay/timer code directly. Could be an interaction.
jen: @ryan can you try reproducing with added sleeps around Shutdown() or swap in a fake clock to remove nondet timing?
ryan: quick hack: adding `time.Sleep(5 * time.Millisecond)` before `Shutdown()` locally reduced failures to ~0/20. I'll try converting the test to use a manual clock next.
maria: If it's the PR, can we bisect? Sam volunteers to bisect if you drop the commit range.
sam: @ryan drop the git range and I'll run bisection on CI/locally. Also good to add `t.Logf` outputs to capture timer state.
ryan: Range: main..origin/merge/1452. I'll push a wip branch with extra logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/main...wip/timer-logs-1918
ci-bot: Build 33155 rerun #2 completed — still red (fail count 2).
sam: Starting bisection locally now. Will post progress. If anyone sees a green CI run, please ping here.
jen: If we confirm shutdown ordering, long-term fix should ensure timers are drained before finalizing executor; short-term we can add a flake guard in test (retry/small sleep) so CI stays green.
lee: Agree. If bisection points to my change I'll prepare a minimal ordering tweak to flush pending timers before Shutdown() completes.
ryan: I'll keep this thread updated with repro logs and any bisect results. local reproduce command I'm using:
```
# reproduce loop
for i in {1..50}; do go test ./serving -run TestExecutorDelayedTimer -count=1 || break; done
```
maria: :thumbsup: ping me when bisect narrows down the commit, happy to help with test cleanup.
